# BCS Regional Atlas (QGIS)

Ready-to-open regional map pack for Baja California Sur.

## Open

1. Install [QGIS](https://qgis.org) 3.28+ if needed.
2. Double-click `BCS_regional.qgz` (or open `BCS_regional.qgs`).
3. Keep `BCS_regional.gpkg` next to the project file (relative paths).

If a layer fails to load: **Browser panel → GeoPackage → BCS_regional.gpkg → drag layers** into the map.

## Layers (GeoPackage)

| Layer | Content | Default |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `poer_ugas` | POERBCS UGAs (2D, preferred) | on |
| `poer_ugas_01` / `_02` | Raw POER shapefile imports | off |
| `anp_federales` | Federal protected areas (BCS clip) | on |
| `rtp_conabio` | CONABIO priority regions | off |
| `ran_nucleos` | RAN agrarian nuclei polygons | on |
| `settlements` | Cabeceras + main localities (~77) | on |
| `highway_nodes` | Named corridor nodes from Earth Studio study | on |
| `stills_points` | ~1000 Earth Studio still camera points | off |

CRS: **EPSG:4326 (WGS 84)**. Extent covers the peninsula.

## Suggested basemap

In QGIS: **Browser → XYZ Tiles → OpenStreetMap**, or add Google/Esri satellite via XYZ URL. Project stays offline-capable without basemap.

## Suggested next layers

- INEGI Marco Geoestadístico (municipios / localidades AGEB)
- SCT / OpenStreetMap highways as lines
- CONAGUA aquifers (from `02_water`)
- Tourism assets CSV → points

## Sources

Built from `13_territorial_intelligence/_raw` (POER shapes, ANP, RTP, RAN KML) plus stills/settlement CSVs. See sibling `maps_catalog/` for the full map inventory.

## Folder layout

```
14_gis_atlas/
  BCS_regional.qgz      ← open this
  BCS_regional.qgs
  BCS_regional.gpkg     ← all vectors
  csv/                  ← source point tables
  styles/               ← optional QML
  README.md
```
